Prepare a verified local deployment plan. Region must remain eu-west-1 and release v1.4.
Call start_job once with ids=["validation"] to start validation. Results and durations are unknown until acquired.
There is no independent work and no module edits are required.
Use every required validation result, retaining its maxBatch. Mark status blocked if any job failed or release was revoked; otherwise ready. Never deploy or contact other services.
Acquire final results using await_jobs, aggregating all IDs in one call. Complete independent work first when useful. Do not repeatedly query job status.
When all required final results are known, save the plan with submit_plan, including region, release, maxBatch, status, and jobIds. Do not include irrelevant cafeteria events in the plan. Briefly explain the outcome.

tools.name: start_job
tools.description: Start the requested validation jobs asynchronously; IDs are returned.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read job statuses and any final results, aggregating all IDs.

tools.name: await_jobs
tools.description: Wait for all requested jobs in one call; inference is suspended while waiting.

tools.name: pause
tools.description: Wait 0–30 seconds without inference; complete this call before the next status check.

tools.name: read_files
tools.description: Read all fixture modules or a selected module. These are real local files.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Replace one fixture module with its complete corrected source. Preserve FACTOR and OFFSET.

tools.name: verify_files
tools.description: Run the real Node tests for every fixture module.

tools.name: submit_plan
tools.description: Save the final plan after all required results are known. Does not deploy.
